description: This PHP class defines the Favourite model for managing user's favorite projects within the Goteo application. It includes methods for retrieving, checking, and managing favorite status, as well as persisting data to the database.

classes.name: Favourite
classes.description: Represents user's favorite projects, providing functionality for retrieval, validation, saving, and removal of favorite project relationships.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the favourite record for a specific project.

methods.name: isFavouriteProject
methods.description: Checks if a specific project is marked as favourite by a specific user.

methods.name: usersSentToday
methods.description: Returns a list of users who have marked the project as favourite and are scheduled to receive notifications today.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the favourite object has required fields set.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the favourite record to the database after validation.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the project from a user's list of favourites.
